rules: A/B is not blanket legal approval
No activation of B statistics until controller records approval
No visitors/IP+UA hashes, ad joins or unique-visitor metric in v1 operations
Existing necessary security/accounting exceptions require documented purpose and expiry

operations.purpose: Detect failures in delivery of a requested service
operations.data: Allowlisted error class, normalized route, method, bounded digest and internal request UUID; no message, stack, request headers or query
operations.terminalAccess: No new browser storage or identifier read
operations.consentGate: none for narrowly justified operational diagnostics
operations.retention: Existing provider retention not changed; provider-side 7-day policy remains a release review item
operations.evidence: Local minimization tests only; Next.js may also emit independent framework error logs

operations.purpose: Existing server performance/error tracing, not a visitor journey
operations.data: OpenTelemetry spans and internal trace IDs; emitted URL, exception and resource attributes require provider inspection
operations.terminalAccess: Server-side only; not itself a terminal-access exemption for reused identifiers
operations.consentGate: Existing operational pipeline unchanged; no approval of additional statistical use
operations.gdprBasis: Purpose-specific necessity, minimization and retention review remains open
operations.retention: Provider configuration not changed or certified by this implementation
operations.evidence: Registration verified in source; no claim that all provider spans/automatic error logs are sanitized. Production privacy gate remains open

operations.purpose: Deliver requested pages, routing, CDN/TLS, bounded security
operations.data: Request/response metadata; transient network addressing
operations.terminalAccess: Communication/strict necessity exception, scope-specific
operations.gdprBasis: Art 6(1)(b); separately assessed security interest under (f)
operations.retention: Provider retention separately controlled; not changed here
operations.evidence: Existing necessary path retained; no normal browser correlation token

operations.purpose: Cart/authentication and checkout explicitly requested by user
operations.data: Necessary cart/session/order identifiers and selected goods
operations.terminalAccess: Strict necessity only for requested function
operations.retention: Existing commerce/accounting rules unchanged
operations.evidence: No payment/order creation performed in this task

operations.purpose: Remember and communicate explicit privacy choice
operations.data: Cookiebot consent state and consent proof
operations.terminalAccess: Necessary consent-state storage
operations.recipients: Cookiebot by Usercentrics; Shopify privacy bridge; GTM consent state
operations.gdprBasis: Documented compliance duty/interest; not advertising consent itself
operations.retention: Existing published consent-proof retention; controller review
operations.evidence: Exactly one loader remains required; GTM/Cookiebot publication pending

operations.purpose: Display privacy dialog at chosen UX moment
operations.data: Visible elapsed milliseconds, scroll threshold boolean, pathname change
operations.terminalAccess: Volatile UI state only; no cookies, persistent storage, IDs or network
operations.gdprBasis: No separate user profile; necessary presentation logic
operations.retention: Page memory only
operations.evidence: Local timing tests and isolated browser preview

operations.purpose: Detect software failures and consent-component availability
operations.data: Allowlisted error class/code, normalized route and bounded line/column; no message content, click ID, stack or browser profile
operations.terminalAccess: Browser error handling; separate necessity/interest assessment
operations.gdprBasis: Candidate Art 6(1)(f): retain documented necessity and balancing assessment
operations.retention: Existing provider runtime retention up to 30d; seven-day provider setting NOT implemented
operations.evidence: Minimization before network serialization and again server-side; controller review required

operations.purpose: Investigate service response, routing and availability
operations.data: Normalized route, HTTP status, infra regions, cache, byte count; bounded internal request/log/trace IDs for debugging only
operations.terminalAccess: Server data; no client storage access
operations.gdprBasis: Candidate Art 6(1)(f), purpose limited; approval record required before release
operations.retention: New operational_v1 rows <7d with hourly cleanup; legacy rules untouched; documented legal holds excepted
operations.evidence: Migration/function not deployed; no ad fields, browser class, referrer, HMAC or visitor linkage

operations.purpose: Daily aggregate service/traffic overview, not unique visitors or advertising attribution
operations.data: Day, normalized route, environment/source, HTTP status, observation and byte totals
operations.terminalAccess: Server aggregation without person/request/trace IDs
operations.gdprBasis: Not yet approved; necessity, balancing and terminal-access analysis must be documented
operations.retention: 90 calendar days including current day; no lifetime aggregates
operations.evidence: OFF by default; private approval control required; no IP/UA hash; no fabricated latency

operations.purpose: Load sole CMP owner and propagate denied category defaults
operations.data: Container request and CMP consent state; no optional tag permitted before category
operations.terminalAccess: Bootstrap/CMP distinct from downstream measurement
operations.gdprBasis: Necessary CMP loading separated from consent-based vendor processing
operations.retention: No new user event storage in app bootstrap
operations.evidence: Live version 160 inspected; 172-174 lack extra consent settings; no publish

operations.purpose: Optional website analytics
operations.data: Provider-defined request data and 24h identifier, event URL with query removed
operations.terminalAccess: Not presumed necessary or anonymous
operations.retention: Vendor contract; 24h identifier is NOT total aggregate retention
operations.evidence: Mount after explicit statistics; beforeSend rechecks; existing grant changes reload

operations.purpose: Optional browser performance analytics
operations.data: Browser performance metrics; current URL stripped of query
operations.terminalAccess: Browser performance APIs, not classified as plain server operations
operations.retention: Vendor contract; separate from ops 7d/90d
operations.evidence: After statistics; beforeSend rechecks

operations.purpose: Optional first-party performance analysis
operations.data: Current page metrics and consented canonical event context
operations.terminalAccess: Browser APIs after statistics choice
operations.retention: Existing canonical retention; not a new consent-free operation
operations.evidence: Hook mounted only after statistics

operations.purpose: Measure current permitted views and commerce actions
operations.data: Canonical event/time/IDs; purpose-filtered browser, product, click and device context
operations.terminalAccess: Relevant consent required before construction, identifier reads or dispatch
operations.recipients: Utekos collector / Supabase; separately permitted providers
operations.retention: Existing canonical ledger policy (14 months); not extended
operations.evidence: Unknown/denied dropped; no historical replay; retry IDs preserved

operations.purpose: Bounded recovery of already consented page events
operations.data: Filtered granted-only current event
operations.terminalAccess: No collection for pending/denied
operations.retention: Existing expiry unchanged; no historical bulk deletion
operations.evidence: Old pending/denied clients receive consent_required without payload logging/persistence

operations.purpose: Consent-based advertising attribution
operations.data: fbclid, gclid, msclkid, epik, Snapchat click; marketing browser IDs
operations.terminalAccess: Read AND write after marketing consent; persist=false returns before any storage or URL interpretation
operations.retention: Existing consented identifier TTLs; no preconsent memory stash
operations.evidence: Storage access negative tests; no Snapchat preconsent replay

operations.purpose: Consent-based page sequence
operations.data: Session journey ID and preceding page-view ID
operations.terminalAccess: Session storage only with statistics consent
operations.retention: Existing canonical/journey retention
operations.evidence: No journey storage access without statistics; not an operational visitor counter

operations.purpose: Ad conversion measurement and matching
operations.data: Consented canonical IDs, content/value, fbp/fbc/external ID and permitted customer signals
operations.terminalAccess: Consent applies to browser and server; no server-side exception
operations.retention: Existing provider/ledger policy; no preconsent rows
operations.evidence: No source-denied replay; current consent rechecked; provider dedup must be validated after release

operations.purpose: Microsoft ad conversion measurement and ID sync
operations.data: Consent-permitted events, click/browser IDs
operations.terminalAccess: All UET tags must require marketing storage/user-data/personalization grants
operations.retention: Existing vendor/ledger policy
operations.evidence: Prepared explicit requirements for 160 and 172-174, not published

operations.purpose: Optional usability analysis
operations.data: Provider-defined page/interaction data
operations.terminalAccess: Statistics consent; advertising linkage requires separate marketing check
operations.retention: Vendor policy; not ops 7d/90d
operations.evidence: Live extra statistics gate inspected; browser/advertising-link readback pending

operations.purpose: Optional statistics
operations.data: Statistics-permitted canonical current events and GA identifiers
operations.terminalAccess: Statistics consent; no pre-choice GA4 event submission in v1
operations.retention: Existing GA/warehouse policy
operations.evidence: Published extra analytics_storage requirements inspected

operations.purpose: Ad event measurement
operations.data: Consent-permitted product events, vendor IDs and matching signals
operations.terminalAccess: Marketing before SDK and event handling
operations.retention: Existing provider policy
operations.evidence: Updated source/live gates; old denied events discarded

operations.purpose: Necessary commerce state separated from optional attribution
operations.data: Consent state and commerce context; only consented IDs may accompany attribution
operations.terminalAccess: Necessary checkout independent; optional attribution gated
operations.recipients: Shopify; Redis checkout coordination; Supabase; permitted providers
operations.retention: Existing order and attribution schedules kept separate
operations.evidence: Unknown/refused state usable without attribution identifiers; real checkout/provider parity pending

operations.purpose: Previously joined edge requests to visitors/consent stages
operations.data: No new processing
operations.terminalAccess: Retired, including cached old clients
operations.retention: Historical rows retain existing expiry; no mass deletion
operations.evidence: 410 without reading request payload or importing database

operations.purpose: Necessary paid-order reconciliation versus optional advertising export
operations.data: Order records separated from consent-qualified marketing queues
operations.terminalAccess: Necessary server order processing is not ad consent
operations.recipients: Shopify/Supabase; providers only per explicit category
operations.retention: Existing accounting retention and separate marketing limits
operations.evidence: Not a new webhook implementation; end-to-end Purchase/AddShippingInfo/AddPaymentInfo must be reverified

operations.purpose: Observe campaign-linked landing cohorts and subsequent permitted engagement
operations.data: Analytics journey ID and validated UTM campaign labels, sections and progress
operations.terminalAccess: Requires both statistics and marketing before session storage or ad-cohort qualification
operations.retention: Existing consented journey policy; not new consent-free statistics
operations.evidence: New and legacy advertising-journey requests require both purposes; ordinary canonical statistics-only journey context remains available
